quests.instruction: Which family member drinks from a bottle and wears soft, tiny clothes?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member cannot feed themselves yet.
quests.explanation: Baby drinks from a bottle and wears soft, tiny clothes since they are very young.
quests.funFact: A newborn baby's tiny hand can wrap all the way around just one adult finger!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the female parent in your family?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Think about who gave birth to you.
quests.explanation: Mother is the female parent in your family.
quests.funFact: The word 'mother' is used in almost every language in the world!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy your parents call 'their son', just like you might be their son or daughter?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He shares the very same mom and dad as you.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy your parents also call their son, sharing the same family as you.
quests.funFact: A family might have one son, several sons, or none at all — every family is different!

quests.instruction: Which family member do you usually see standing next to your mother in family photos?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is a man and one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father often stands with mother in family photos since he is one of your parents.
quests.funFact: Looking back at old family photos is a fun way to see how everyone has grown!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl, not a parent, who shares your exact same mom and dad?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: Think about a girl close to your own age at home.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl, not a parent, who shares your exact same mom and dad.
quests.funFact: Brothers and sisters together are sometimes called 'siblings' as a group word!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the newest addition to the family?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is very small and very young.
quests.explanation: Baby is often the newest addition to a family.
quests.funFact: Newborn babies usually sleep for most of the day and night!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your father's partner in taking care of you?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is a woman, and together with your father, she is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother works together with father to take care of you as one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Both parents usually share the job of taking care of their children together!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy, not a parent, who shares your exact same mom and dad?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: Think about a boy close to your own age at home.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy, not a parent, who shares your exact same mom and dad.
quests.funFact: A brother can be a great person to practice sharing and taking turns with!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one of your two parents and also a man?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is your mother's husband.
quests.explanation: Father is one of your two parents and is a man.
quests.funFact: Every family looks different, but everyone has a father who is part of their story!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl child in the family, in the same generation as you?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: Think about a girl who calls your parents 'Mom' and 'Dad' too.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl in the same generation as you, sharing the same parents.
quests.funFact: Some families have more than one sister, making a whole team of siblings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is too young to have any brothers or sisters of their own yet?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This is the youngest family member, still learning to crawl or walk.
quests.explanation: Baby is the youngest family member, too young to have children of their own.
quests.funFact: As a baby grows older, they slowly learn to crawl, then stand, and then walk!

quests.instruction: Which family member do many children call 'Mom' or 'Mommy'?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: This person is a grown woman who is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother is the name many children use for the woman who is one of their two parents.
quests.funFact: Many countries celebrate a special holiday just to celebrate mothers!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who is neither your father nor your baby cousin, but shares your parents?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is your own age group in the family.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy who shares your parents and is your own age group, unlike your father.
quests.funFact: Brothers often teach each other new tricks, like whistling or catching a ball!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grown-up man who is one of your two parents?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: This is not your brother — he is one generation older than you.
quests.explanation: Father is a grown-up man who is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: A father and his child sometimes share the very same laugh!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who plays and grows up alongside you in the same family?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is your own age group, sharing your parents.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl who plays and grows up alongside you, sharing your parents.
quests.funFact: Many childhood memories are made playing games together with brothers and sisters!

quests.instruction: Which family member needs help with absolutely everything, from eating to getting dressed?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is the youngest in the whole family.
quests.explanation: Baby needs help with everything since they are the youngest and cannot do things alone yet.
quests.funFact: Learning to sit up, crawl, and walk are all big milestones for a growing baby!

quests.instruction: Which family member do you usually see standing next to your father in family photos?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is a woman and one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother often stands with father in family photos since she is one of your parents.
quests.funFact: Family photos are a wonderful way to remember happy moments together!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy child in the family, in the same generation as you?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: Think about a boy who calls your parents 'Mom' and 'Dad' too.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy in the same generation as you, sharing the same parents.
quests.funFact: Some families have more than one brother, making a whole team of siblings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your mom's husband and one of your two parents?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is a man in the family.
quests.explanation: Father is your mom's husband and one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Fathers and mothers work as a team to take care of their children!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who is neither your mother nor your baby cousin, but shares your parents?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is your own age group in the family.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl who shares your parents and is your own age group, unlike your mother.
quests.funFact: Sisters often help each other learn new things, like riding a bike or reading a new word!

quests.instruction: Which family member has the softest, smallest hands and feet in the house?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is the newest, youngest one in the family.
quests.explanation: Baby has the smallest hands and feet since they are the youngest family member.
quests.funFact: A baby's bones are actually softer and more flexible than a grown-up's bones!

quests.instruction: Which family member gave birth to you?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Mom' at home.
quests.explanation: Mother is the woman who gave birth to you.
quests.funFact: Every person in the world has exactly one mother who gave birth to them!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a son of your mother and father, other than you?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: This family member is a boy in your own generation.
quests.explanation: Brother is a son of your mother and father, just like you but a different person.
quests.funFact: Many brothers grow up sharing a room full of toys and games!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the man who is your parent, not your brother?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is married to your mother.
quests.explanation: Father is your parent and a man, different from your brother, who is your own age group.
quests.funFact: Fathers around the world are known by many different loving nicknames too!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who grew up in the same house as you, with the same parents?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is your own age group, not a parent.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl who grew up with you, sharing the same parents and home.
quests.funFact: Siblings who grow up together often become each other's very first best friends!

quests.instruction: Which family member rides in a stroller instead of walking on their own?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member cannot walk long distances yet.
quests.explanation: Baby rides in a stroller since they cannot walk long distances on their own yet.
quests.funFact: The very first stroller-like baby carriages were invented hundreds of years ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grown-up woman who is one of your two parents?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: This is not your sister — she is one generation older than you.
quests.explanation: Mother is a grown-up woman who is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Around the world, people call their mother by many different loving nicknames!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is a boy shown on the same level as you?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He shares your parents, not your generation above.
quests.explanation: Brother appears on the same level as you on a family tree, since you share the same parents.
quests.funFact: Drawing your own family tree is a fun way to see exactly how everyone is connected!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man who is one generation older than you, and is your parent?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Daddy'.
quests.explanation: Father is a man who is one generation older than you and is your parent.
quests.funFact: Grown-ups are often taller than kids, which makes fathers easy to spot in a family photo!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is a girl shown on the same level as you?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She shares your parents, not your generation above.
quests.explanation: Sister appears on the same level as you on a family tree, since you share the same parents.
quests.funFact: A family tree shows brothers and sisters side by side on the very same branch level!
